LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateServices.Summary: Build lifetime trade to unlock order discounts, broader stock, weekly gifts, free personnel and targeted combat support.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateServices.Counting: Purchases and sales count, including stock, orders and corporate caravan or settlement deals. Each Mugirl counts only on her first paid personnel trade, using the actual amount paid or received. Trading her again adds no turnover. Orders count on delivery; refunds, gifts and financial transfers do not. Existing saves start tracking new trades after this update.

LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateServices.Tier3: VIP client: 10% off orders, 12 additional stock types and a wider selection of spacer goods. Weekly gift: 10 industrial medicine and 20 packaged survival meals.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateServices.Tier4: Strategic client: 12% off orders and 16 additional stock types. Purchase one Mugirl from the weekly roster for free, as a slave or colonist. Slave purchases require Ideology.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateServices.Tier5: Premier client: 15% off orders and 24 additional stock types. Call four well-equipped Mugirl strike troopers once per week, free of charge, to an outdoor landing cell on a loaded map. All bear the corporate diehard trait: they never retreat, and friendly-fire goodwill losses are reduced by 95%. They withdraw after one day.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateServices.Tier6: Elite client: retain all premier benefits. Support increases to eight troopers per call and two free calls per week. Calls already used this week still count.
